name: Combat Quasar Regression
description: Regression tests for quasar cannon mechanics (sector and atmosphere)

tests.name: Rig: Remove stale Quasar warp links

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_warps WHERE (from_sector = 1 AND to_sector = 9999) OR (from_sector = 9999 AND to_sector = 1);

tests.name: Rig: Remove stale Quasar acceptance planet
Rig: Create deterministic Quasar planet at sector 9999

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (planet_id, num, sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, type, created_by, fighters) SELECT 977730, 1, 9999, 'V3 Quasar Regression Planet', player_id, 'player', 'M', (SELECT planettypes_id FROM planettypes WHERE code = 'M' LIMIT 1), player_id, 0 FROM players WHERE name = 'admin' RETURNING planet_id, sector_id;
INSERT INTO sector_warps (from_sector, to_sector) VALUES (1, @{target_sector_id}), (@{target_sector_id}, 1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Rig: Set survivable deterministic Quasar strengths

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels (planet_id, level, owner_id, qCannonSector, qCannonAtmosphere, militaryReactionLevel, planetaryShields) VALUES (@{target_planet_id}, 3, (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'admin'), 1, 1, 0, 0) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level = 3, owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id, qCannonSector = 1, qCannonAtmosphere = 1, militaryReactionLevel = 0, planetaryShields = 0;

tests.name: Rig: Position victim_user player at Sector 1

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 1 WHERE name = 'victim_user';

tests.name: Rig: Position victim_user ship at Sector 1

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 1, hull = 100, shields = 0, fighters = 20, onplanet = FALSE, cloaked = NULL WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'victim_user');

tests.name: Victim Gets Hull Status Before Warp
Victim Warps to Quasar Sector (Should Take Damage)
Verify Victim Took Sector Quasar Damage
Victim Warps Back to Quasar Sector (Should Take Damage Again)
Capture hull before hostile planetary landing
Atmosphere Quasar fires during an unauthorized landing attempt
Verify Event Logging - Check Combat Log

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='combat.hit.quasar' AND actor_player_id=@{victim_user_player_id} AND payload::jsonb->>'source'='Planet atmosphere Quasar' AND (payload::jsonb->>'planet_id')::int=@{target_planet_id};
